content:
olivia: Quick heads-up — Zenport week0 onboarding: hit a KMS cross-account key policy mismatch and their infra team blocked audit-log forwarding to our SIEM. Need coordinated unblock today.
matt: Which policy exactly? can you paste the error from their side?
olivia: They get "AccessDenied" on Encrypt/Decrypt for the key alias we provided. Their infra says the key policy doesn't include the customer's backup account (they're using shared KMS account). snippet:
```json
{"error":"AccessDenied","action":"kms:Decrypt","key":"alias/zenport-redwood"}
```
matt: Okay — likely missing `Principal` ARN for their infra role. @dena can you confirm if customer opted into cross-account key share or dedicated CMK?
dena: They asked for shared KMS to keep key rotation centralized. I flagged this morning that we'd need explicit role ARNs. I can get the exact role name from their SRE.
jordan: On audit logs — Zenport routed CloudTrail -> S3 -> our ingestion but object ACLs are blocking `redwood-sys` role. Getting 403 on PutObject.
olivia: Yeah that's the second blocker. Their security wants to restrict bucket ACLs. We proposed a bucket policy allowing PutObject from redwood-ingest principal. Picking up with them now.
matt: Main risk is renewal signal — if Week0 stalls more than 5 business days, account moves to 'engaged AE' and renewal conversation speeds up. Let's avoid that.
dena: Action items: 1) I will get SRE role ARN by EOD. 2) @jordan can you draft the minimal key policy snippet we can share? 3) olivia, can you ask them for bucket policy that returns the 403 request-id? :thumbsup:
jordan: Drafted key policy here:
```json
{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/zenport-sre"},"Action":["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],"Resource":"*"}]}
```
jordan: Also added CMP note about not granting kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion.
olivia: Sharing both snippets now. Also capturing feedback: Zenport wants clearer pre-onboard checklist re: cross-account KMS and bucket ownership — they said last runbooks were ambiguous.
matt: Noted — that's product feedback for CS playbook. For now, if they supply role ARN and update bucket policy, we can finish telemetry and move to smoke tests tomorrow.
dena: I'll follow up with SRE on role ARN + estimate. tagging ops-bot to create follow-up ticket.
ops-bot: Ticket created: CS-9721 — Zenport KMS + audit-log unblock. Assignee: dena. ETA: 48h.
olivia: Great. We'll reconvene in ~2h or on this thread when they reply.
